difficulty_reason: H2: positivity of a Rauzy matrix or rational linear independence of its columns alone does not produce a simple admissible word with good returns generating the full integer lattice. The author constructs a periodic positive loop power whose substitution images share a first letter, doubles it so every image is a good return in every substituted symbol, uses Rauzy unimodularity for integral rather than just rational generation, and prefixes a sufficiently long cycle of the opposite edge type to enforce nonoverlap without losing the return properties. This simultaneous constructive control is the lemma-specific nonroutine core; its entire proof is retained.

proof_roadmap: Take a positive Rauzy loop and a power with a common initial letter.
Double the power to force its substitution images to be good returns.
Identify their population vectors with unimodular matrix columns.
Prefix a long opposite-label cycle and a closing cycle to make the full word simple.
